cards.name: A-Rulik Mons, Warren Chief
cards.oracleText:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Whenever Rulik Mons, Warren Chief enters or attacks, look at the top card of your library. If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you didn't put a card onto the battlefield this way, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
